purpose: Portable PR43 local runtime evidence; screenshot binaries retained selectively and omissions explicitly hash-only.
depends_on: 630e1c86 source hashes, 91b9a6a8 source hashes, synthetic Go/PG browser fixtures and original raw logs.
used_by: verify-evidence.mjs and independent PR43 review; no scratch access required.
normalization: Raw artifacts remain untouched. Copies replace worktree/repository machine prefixes with dot, ephemeral var/folders or tmp directories with <TMP>. Original and view SHA256 are recorded. Pixel bytes are unchanged. Original out/run values are historical provenance, never DELIVERY links. Published text also strips trailing whitespace and extra EOF blank lines; no assertion, exit code or measured value changes.
